explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Pottawatomie massacre" (revision 1374859516) says: "In reaction to the sacking of Lawrence by pro-slavery forces on May 21, and the telegraphed news of the severe attack on Massachusetts Senator Charles Sumner, John Brown and a band of abolitionist settlers—some of them members of the Pottawatomie Rifles—responded violently." The edge reads that sentence as: Pottawatomie massacre was a response to Sacking of Lawrence, and nothing more.
